europe_now.title: Spanish Transport Minister Resigns
europe_now.summary: Spain's transport minister has resigned following a deadly train crash, prompting significant political fallout.

europe_now.title: Escalating Attacks and Casualties in Ukraine
europe_now.summary: The conflict in Ukraine continues to see rising casualties following recent Russian strikes targeting hospitals and aid infrastructure.

top_stories.title: Polish Institutional Disputes
top_stories.summary: Clashes between political leaders in Poland have intensified over the direction of the country's top constitutional court. The disputed institution recently held its first meeting following a takeover by government-backed judges.

top_stories.title: EU Enlargement and Reforms
top_stories.summary: The European Commission has advised Ukraine to accelerate critical domestic reforms while establishing a more cautious framework for its accession. This decision outlines a measured path toward future European Union membership.
